name: grid-list
gotchas: `cols` and `rowHeight` are both effectively required — omitting `rowHeight` doesn't fall back to content-driven sizing, it defaults to a 1:1 ratio, which surprises people expecting tiles to size themselves to their content.

A tile's position is decided by MatGridList's own fill-in layout algorithm based on template order, not independent x/y coordinates — reordering `mat-grid-tile` elements (or changing an earlier tile's `colspan`/`rowspan`) shifts which cells every later tile occupies.

`rowHeight="fit"` divides the grid list's own element height by the row count, so the `mat-grid-list` needs an explicit height from a parent (e.g. a fixed-height container) — without one, `fit` collapses every tile to zero height.
